card.name: Inside brand-name biologic drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through brand or generic names of newer injectable or oncology drugs, such as Erbitux, Vectibix, Phesgo, Pegasys and natalizumab. It also fires on some spaces before numbers or parentheses in the same label text.

modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or generic name of an antibody or targeted drug.
modes.example: Administer Er<<bit>>ux as a single-agent or in combination

modes.label: Space before number or bracket
modes.description: A space token just before a grade, codon number or opening parenthesis in label text.
